**Suggest a new vehicle and provide details below.**
Please provide:
- Name in English
- Link to data source (e.g. Wikipedia or something vaguely trustworthy)
- Intro year
- Region & Country 
- Type (ie metro, engine, MU, whatever)
- Weight preferably in standard tons
- Speed in KM/H
- Power in HP
- Length in tiles if you can, otherwise in meters or something comparable
- Starting (not continous) tractive effort if applicable preferably in kN. Use AI if you need to.
- Capacity if applicable (0 if not)
- Rail type (standard/narrow/broad gauge)
- Voltage if applicable (25kV AC, 15kV AC, 3kV DC, 1500V DC, 3rd rail, 4th rail, OHLE [ie more than one overhead type], dual [ie OHLE _and_ 3rd rail] no power)
- ** Please provide graphics if you can ** using an existing template, else suggest an existing vehicle that looks similar enough to clone/modify. I'm bad at gfx.
